research_only_artifacts.encoding_note: All pixels are finite and in [0, 1]; 0.0 is written outside the survey footprint (nan_cells = 0, values_outside_0_1 = 0). The official format text asks for null/nan outside the data bounds, so both encodings are locally defensible; the all-finite encoding additionally cannot fail a naive `0 <= v <= 1` portal check, which is the class of error the user reported. No truth pixels exist outside the footprint, so the outside-footprint value cannot change the score.
